title: A Counterexample to the Holomorphic Cancellation Problem
summary: We show that if a contractible Stein manifold $X$ with the density property admits a proper holomorphic embedding into $\mathbb{C}^k$, then $X \times \mathbb{C}^k$ is biholomorphic to $\mathbb{C}^{n+k}$ with $n=\dim X$. We also prove that McLean's exotic affine variety $K_n$, $n\ge4$, a smooth contractible affine variety which is not biholomorphic to $\mathbb{C}^n$, has the density property.
